scripts.title: LoffyHUb
scripts.features:
THE MAIN TRICKS
Spam-Roll without the Vomit Camera: Turning on Auto Roll forces a background bypass (TweenService metatable injection) that instantly kills the game's annoying script-forced zoom. You can roll indefinitely at 0.3s intervals without your camera twitching or breaking your perspective.

Zero-Delay Parallel Buying: Most scripts lag because they check names sequentially. This uses a real-time event listener (ChildAdded) connected directly to the machine. The exact frame a seed spawns, the script checks your toggles and buys it instantly in parallel.

The 6-Garden Vacuum: Instead of just checking the top folder, Auto Pick Up runs a deep-descendant sweep that digs through all 6 plots simultaneously. It treats the active pepper instances as direct targets so nothing gets stuck in the soil.

THE BREWING ENGINE
Smart Heat Sort (High ➔ Low): It doesn't just blindly grab random inventory slots. The algorithm parses the exact text values on your pepper labels, ranks your entire backpack from highest heat to lowest heat, and feeds the hottest fruits into the pot first to maximize your batch quality.

Decoupled Claim Flow: The script splits adding and claiming into two separate modules. You can set a precise batch limit (like 100), let the auto-adder dump them in and halt, and leave the standalone Auto Claim running to handle the boiling cycles exactly how you want.

THE TRADING DESK
Bulk Shelf Placements: You can override the game's default 1-by-1 bottleneck. Set your multiplier anywhere from 1 to 5, and the loop will grab your hot sauce UUID tags and slap down a full batch onto your open sales slots at a steady, calibrated 0.5-second pace to keep you from getting rate-limited by the server.

scripts.script:
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- Cleanup existing
if player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("CrxshhyHub") then player.PlayerGui.CrxshhyHub:Destroy() end

local running = true
local autoFarmEnabled = false
local speedEnabled = false
local addPeppersEnabled = false
local currentTargetSpeed = 50
local isHoldingJump = false
local menuKey = Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt
local bindingMode = false

--// 1. UI CREATION
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
ScreenGui.Name = "CrxshhyHub"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local Main = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
Main.Name = "Main"
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 560)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -280)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", Main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
Instance.new("UIStroke", Main).Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255)
Instance.new("UIStroke", Main).Thickness = 3

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Main)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
Title.Text = "CRXSHHY HUB"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 22
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local function createButton(text, yPos)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", Main)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 35)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, yPos)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 14
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    return btn
end

local AutoFarmBtn = createButton("AUTO FARM: OFF", 60)
local AddPeppersBtn = createButton("ADD PEPPERS: OFF", 105)
AddPeppersBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
local InfJumpBtn = createButton("INF JUMP: OFF", 150)
local SpeedToggleBtn = createButton("SPEED SYSTEM: OFF", 195)

local SpeedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", Main)
SpeedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
SpeedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 235)
SpeedLabel.Text = "SPEED: 50"
SpeedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
SpeedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
SpeedLabel.TextSize = 16
SpeedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local SliderBar = Instance.new("TextButton", Main)
SliderBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 6)
SliderBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 265)
SliderBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
SliderBar.Text = ""
Instance.new("UICorner", SliderBar)
local SliderBtn = Instance.new("Frame", SliderBar)
SliderBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
SliderBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -8)
SliderBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255)
Instance.new("UICorner", SliderBtn)

--// 2. LOGIC
AutoFarmBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    autoFarmEnabled = not autoFarmEnabled
    AutoFarmBtn.Text = autoFarmEnabled and "AUTO FARM: ON" or "AUTO FARM: OFF"
    AutoFarmBtn.TextColor3 = autoFarmEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
end)

AddPeppersBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    addPeppersEnabled = not addPeppersEnabled
    AddPeppersBtn.Text = addPeppersEnabled and "ADD PEPPERS: ON" or "ADD PEPPERS: OFF"
    AddPeppersBtn.TextColor3 = addPeppersEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)
end)

SpeedToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    speedEnabled = not speedEnabled
    SpeedToggleBtn.Text = speedEnabled and "SPEED SYSTEM: ON" or "SPEED SYSTEM: OFF"
    SpeedToggleBtn.TextColor3 = speedEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
end)

InfJumpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isHoldingJump = not isHoldingJump
    InfJumpBtn.Text = isHoldingJump and "INF JUMP: ON" or "INF JUMP: OFF"
    InfJumpBtn.TextColor3 = isHoldingJump and Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
end)

--// 3. ENGINE PIPELINES
task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        if autoFarmEnabled and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlayerLots") and workspace.PlayerLots:FindFirstChild("Bellebalap")
            if folder then
                for _, item in pairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if autoFarmEnabled and item.Name == "Crop" then
                        local prompt = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
                        if prompt then
                            player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
                            player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = item:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                            fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                            task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        if addPeppersEnabled then
            local remote = game:FindFirstChild("AddPepper", true)
            local inv = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            if remote and inv then
                for _, item in pairs(inv:GetChildren()) do
                    if not item.Name:lower():find("seed") then
                        pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(false, item.Name) end)
                        task.wait(0.15)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)

-- Menu & Rebind Logic
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if bindingMode then
        menuKey = input.KeyCode
        bindingMode = false
        MenuKeyBtn.Text = "MENU KEY: " .. menuKey.Name
        return
    end
    if not gpe and input.KeyCode == menuKey then
        Main.Visible = not Main.Visible
    end
end)

local sliding = false
SliderBar.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() sliding = true end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then sliding = false end end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if sliding and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local ratio = math.clamp((input.Position.X - SliderBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderBar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        SliderBtn.Position = UDim2.new(ratio, -8, 0.5, -8)
        currentTargetSpeed = math.floor(16 + (ratio * 100))
        SpeedLabel.Text = "SPEED: " .. currentTargetSpeed
    end
end)

local speedConnection
speedConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not running then speedConnection:Disconnect() return end
    local hum = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        if speedEnabled then hum.WalkSpeed = currentTargetSpeed end
        if isHoldingJump then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end)

MenuKeyBtn = createButton("MENU KEY: L-ALT", 405)
MenuKeyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    bindingMode = true
    MenuKeyBtn.Text = "PRESS ANY KEY..."
end)

local Unload = createButton("UNLOAD HUB", 450)
Unload.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
Unload.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
Unload.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    running = false
    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
    end
    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
    end
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)
